name: Ladybird (Wayland)
tagline: The Ladybird browser for Xios desktop sessions
seoTitle: Ladybird browser for iOS and iPad (jailbreak) · xiOS
seoDescription: Run the independent Ladybird browser engine locally on a jailbroken iPad as a native arm64 xiOS Wayland application.
description:
[Ladybird](https://ladybird.org) is a new web browser with its own engine, written from scratch rather than built on WebKit or Chromium. This is the desktop build, which runs locally as a window inside a xiOS session.

It adds a normal application entry and opens through whichever desktop you are running. A compatible rootless jailbreak is required.

If you want a Home Screen browser icon instead, install **Ladybird** (`ladybird-app`).
